integrity: The arbitrary-frame equivalence and all-size enumeration have a complete symbolic argument. Exhaustive finite checks support but do not replace it. No independent audit or validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact enumeration is for ordered labeled pairs of equivalence relations and two agents; the operator criterion assumes a finite nonempty agent set but allows any nonempty world set. No generalization to infinitely many agents or unlabeled frames is claimed; older equivalent results under neighborhood and partition-incidence terminology remain possible.
title: Normality and a Bell-number census for finite-agent someone-knows bundles
